title: Marketing Chief Versioned Execution and Evidence Graph

trigger.event: ranked work selected for bounded execution or verification

pattern.parallelism: Only independent verification nodes may fan out. Dependency-bound work remains sequential.

authority.queueMutationPath: scripts/Accept-WorkerHandoff.ps1 or another supported Marketing Chief mutation script after live stale-state validation
authority.externalActionBoundary: A graph may identify or stage an approval-gated action, but it never authorizes or executes that action.

retrievalPolicy.binding: Exact client, work-item, source-locator, and artifact references are authoritative.
retrievalPolicy.graphUse: Traverse client, work item, evidence, artifact, definition-of-done, approval, handoff, and outcome relationships for bounded context.
retrievalPolicy.semanticUse: Semantic or keyword similarity may suggest context only. It may not bind intake, deduplicate canonical work, select a client, satisfy evidence, or authorize a mutation.
retrievalPolicy.contextLimit: Pass locators and targeted artifacts between nodes, never the full portfolio or raw communications.

stages.input: queue revision, work-item version, registry route
stages.rule: Require one exact active client and an unchanged work-item version. Record queue and work-item hashes.

stages.input: safe opaque source and evidence locators
stages.rule: Store redacted summaries and safe locators only. Reject secrets, direct identifiers, raw communications, path traversal, and cross-client artifact paths.
Load only the exact client context, evidence, artifacts, dependencies, and definition of done needed for the selected item.
No queue write or external action. Respect action class, approval state, WIP lane, project boundary, and node attempt limit.

stages.input: one explicit definition-of-done check and actual output
stages.rule: Create one independently traceable verifier node per definition-of-done check. File existence alone is insufficient.

stages.input: action class, approval state, and exact authority
stages.rule: Automatic local work may proceed. External delivery, publishing, deployment, spend, account changes, destructive work, human authentication, and business decisions fail closed without exact current approval.
Emit the existing bounded redacted handoff contract and include the graph locator and content hash as evidence.

stages.input: validated handoff plus current queue state
stages.rule: Reread current queue revision and item version under the canonical lock. Only the Chief may accept the handoff, increment revisions, regenerate CONTROL.md, and record the receipt.

resumePolicy.resumeRule: Resume only ready nodes whose dependencies are complete and whose live work-item content hash still matches.
resumePolicy.staleRule: If the work-item version or content changes, stop and generate a new graph. An unrelated queue revision advance is recorded but does not invalidate an unchanged item.
resumePolicy.retryRule: A failed node may return to ready only while attempts remain. Approval-blocked nodes cannot be retried into execution.

successSignals: every completed handoff traces to one unchanged work-item version
every definition-of-done check has an explicit verifier node
every accepted handoff retains graph locator and content hash evidence
continue can resume safe work without redoing completed verified nodes
stale or approval-gated work fails closed
